data.text: 0.8.2 verified from the registry: the tag workflow printed '+ kadence@0.8.2' with provenance (sigstore logIndex 3196182712, source commit 3679557); npm view said 0.8.2 at the first check; GitHub release v0.8.2 carries reference.json. Clean npm i -g into a scratch prefix: init on a fresh repo under script(1) drew Coda in petrol with the version; through a pipe it printed 'kadence is ready.' as 0.8.1 does; decision add, prime listed it, search found it. Fixture for 0.8.2 (DOC-64 §4): make-fixtures accepted 24 of 24, compatibility.test.ts 51 of 51. Criterion 1 (tests first) and 4 (timing, core) do not apply to a release; criterion 4 was measured anyway, see the checklist note. Left for the owner: copy dist/reference.json into kadence-site (DOC-64 §5) — the release asset has it.
